summary: Completed phases 1-5 of the 10-phase plan (test runner + Gate 8, scripts/lib/common.sh, session-ID migration, root-resolution/timestamp migration, and the shell-strict-mode.md classification doc). Phase 6 (strict-mode migration batch A) is partial: state-write.sh migrated to set -euo pipefail, audited, and verified with a live fixture exercise plus its two concurrency test suites; the remaining 4 files (task-lock.sh, git-commit-scoped.sh, orchestrate-batch-admit.sh, orchestrate-predispatch-review.sh) were deliberately deferred rather than rushed, since task-lock.sh alone is a 1644-line, concurrency-critical mutex script with dozens of unguarded VAR=$(jq/ps/stat) sites requiring individual audit. Phases 7-10 (remaining strict-mode batch, shebang normalization, and two new test suites) are not started. All committed work is green: run-all.sh passes 27/27 on a clean run (one pre-existing, documented flaky suite -- tests/test-claude-refresh-matcher.sh -- intermittently fails under concurrent-suite load, unrelated to this task's changes).
